providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: No spacecraft has ever visited Sedna; not part of Solar System Scope's illustrative dwarf-planet set (checked live 2026-08-27); even its size is only an estimate. Procedurally generated surface parameterized from Barucci et al. 2010, which explains Sedna's observed spectral/color homogeneity by the rarity of impacts at its extreme distance (impacts are what expose fresh, spectrally distinct ice elsewhere) — rendered with almost no craters and no ice patches, the most uniform of the six generated bodies.
